units.source_text: 像我这样的人，一伏在办公桌上，小便就频繁，

en.t: For someone like me, as soon as I bent over my desk, I had to urinate frequently,

units.source_text: 还要一个劲儿喝茶水，有时还闹神经性腹泻。

en.t: and I would keep drinking tea besides, sometimes even suffering from nervous diarrhea.
Otake, seventh dan, was still more extreme.

units.source_text: 就是在日本棋院举办的春秋两季升段赛上，

en.t: Even at the spring and autumn promotion tournaments held at the Nihon Ki-in,

units.source_text: 大竹七段也把大茶壶放在身边，不停地喝粗茶。

en.t: Otake, seventh dan, would keep a large teapot beside him and drink coarse tea without stopping.

units.source_text: 那时节，大竹七段的好对手吴清源六段也是如此，

en.t: In those days, Otake's worthy rival, Go Seigen, sixth dan, was the same way,

units.source_text: 只要对着棋盘，小便就多了。

en.t: as soon as he faced the go board, he had to urinate more often.

units.source_text: 四五个小时的对局中，我曾试数了一下，约莫在十次以上。

en.t: During a four- or five-hour game, I once tried counting, and it came to more than ten times.

units.source_text: 吴六段并不那么爱喝茶，

en.t: Go, sixth dan, was not especially fond of drinking tea,

units.source_text: 他每回解手，都能听见声音，真是难以想象。

en.t: yet every time he relieved himself, one could hear the sound; it was truly hard to imagine.
Otake, seventh dan, did not only urinate.

units.source_text: 他一上厕所，裙裤自不用说，连腰带也是在走廊上边走边解。

en.t: When he went to the toilet, he would of course loosen his hakama, and even untie his sash while walking down the corridor.
